name: Logitech G500s
notes: 67-byte report descriptor of the mouse interface of a real Logitech G500s, from Linux HID test data for the device: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/libevdev/hid-tools/-/blob/f4a32530ea548df2ae5efd2ebfd16d4c3e658875/tests/test_cli_decode.py#L35-35. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
